title: High Fat Diet Feeding Protocol for Mice
author: Kristin Evans
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xfmfjk6

steps.title: Store High-Fat Diet
steps.instruction: Store the stock bag of high-fat diet in a refrigerator.

steps.title: Initiate Diet Feeding
steps.instruction: Provide high-fat diet ad libitum to mice, typically starting at 6 weeks of age for C57BL/6 strains (or as determined by investigator needs).

steps.title: Maintain Diet Freshness
steps.instruction: Replace the high-fat diet in the cages 2 times a week to prevent spoilage.

steps.title: Monitor Initial Diet Intake
steps.instruction: Pay careful attention to diet intake during the first 2 weeks of feeding, as mice typically eat more during this period.

steps.title: Measure Intake and Weight
steps.instruction: Measure diet intake and animal weights as requested by the investigator.
